title: Attested-derivation expression duplicated verbatim at two handler sites instead of one helper on reference_attestation
evidence:
Site 1 (insert_application, ack-write flag): "            get_form_value(values, reference_attestation.field_name)
              == reference_attestation.attested_value," — Site 2 (finalise_application, confirmation flag): "    reference_contact_attested: get_form_value(
      values,
      reference_attestation.field_name,
    )
      == reference_attestation.attested_value," — AGENTS.md: "DRY: extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places"
detail: The same two-constant comparison is spelled out twice in the handler. The module already owns field_name/attested_value and validate_choice; a small public is_attested(values) predicate keeps one owner and is what the stepper will need on rebase.
recommended_fix: Add pub fn is_attested(values) -> Bool to reference_attestation (get_val |> string.trim == attested_value) and call it at both handler sites.
